steps.name: install-structured-climate-dataset
steps.command: set -euo pipefail; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = af78e99620597e32ffe965aa7c2eaae6234e84a1; git fetch origin agent-control; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage6/climate_scenarios.py > tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage6/climate_dataset.py > tools/ml/climate_dataset.py; git show origin/agent-control:.agent/task-assets/stage6/test_climate_dataset.py > tests/test_climate_dataset.py; .venv/bin/ruff check --fix tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py; .venv/bin/ruff format tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py; git diff --check; git status --short

steps.name: focused-dataset-and-real-audit
steps.command:
set -euo pipefail; .venv/bin/python -m pytest tests/test_climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_teacher.py tests/test_climate_input.py tests/test_climate_simulator.py -q; .venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from tools.ml.climate_dataset import ClimateDatasetConfig, assert_climate_dataset_ready, audit_climate_dataset, generate_climate_dataset
bundle = generate_climate_dataset(ClimateDatasetConfig.quick(seed=1847))
report = audit_climate_dataset(bundle)
print('CLIMATE_V6_QUICK_AUDIT')
for line in report.summary_lines():
    print(line)
print('families=', report.family_counts)
print('splits=', report.split_counts)
print('mean_level=', report.mean_level)
assert_climate_dataset_ready(report)
PY
.venv/bin/ruff check tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py; git diff --check; git diff --stat

verify_steps.name: full-regression-and-publish
verify_steps.command: set -euo pipefail; git add -- tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py; .venv/bin/pre-commit run --all-files; .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -m 'not hardware'; bash scripts/check_schema.sh; cmake -S test/host -B build/host-tests; cmake --build build/host-tests --parallel; ctest --test-dir build/host-tests --output-on-failure; bash scripts/run_clang_tidy_host.sh; git diff --check; git add -- tools/ml/climate_scenarios.py tools/ml/climate_dataset.py tests/test_climate_dataset.py; git diff --cached --check; git commit -m 'Add structured climate v6 dataset audit'; git push origin HEAD:mvp/environment-controller
